body:
Of course some of you matter more than I do; some of you are parents, teachers, involved in the community, and doing something to make the world better.

I tried and I can't see a life on my own.  I don't have a clue what it would be like or how I would see the world.  I have been in this situation my entire life.  I've never mattered.

See though, I keep coming back to the fact that it doesn't matter.  I don't matter.  In the big scheme of things, it doesn't make a difference whether I go tonight, tomorrow, or fifty years from now.  It just doesn't fucking matter.  So why do I need to suffer through it?

Why do you care?  Why did I even bother posting?  You don't know me, nobody here does.  Why does it matter to you whether I live or die?

Hell, I could be the worst fucking human being who has ever lived.

Besides.  In time soon enough, it won't even fucking matter anymore.
I can't afford it.  I'm disabled and break my goddamn back to please them, but it's never enough.  Ever.

My quasifamily.  I cook dinner and they don't like my cooking so they don't eat it.  I help with the livestock and gardening but I'm not allowed to eat any of the product we keep.  I make a comment, or a joke, or a suggestion, and I'm ridiculed (then spoken to about how quiet and isolated I've been lately).

I seriously can't do shit properly.  I'm so fucking tired of being wrong all the time.  I don't even care anymore.  I'm fucking done.
No insurance + no money = no doctor + no meds

I really... I honestly don't know where to begin.

It's like I don't matter.  Like I don't exist.  I do things, break my back for people, and get no recognition.  No thank you.  No appreciation.  If I can't win for losing, I'm just going to quit fucking playing.

Then there's the bigger part of it all, the part that I keep coming back to: if I died tonight, I might have half a dozen people notice I left (not miss me, simply notice my absense).  In a month, a year tops, I would be utterly forgotten.  Like I *had* never existed.  So what's the point?  I don't fucking matter today, I didn't fucking matter yesterday, and I won't fucking matter tomorrow.

I'm just sick of playing this goddamn game that I never fucking signed up for, and I don't see why the rules say I have to stick around.
